page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6e-c12g1.24xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated server instance designed for high-density parallel computing and deep learning workloads. The system is equipped with eight NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs, each providing 32 GB of VRAM for a combined accelerator pool of 256 GB. Host processing is driven by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base clock of 2.5 GHz across 48 physical cores and 96 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading. The configuration also integrates 736 GB of system RAM, allocating approximately 7.67 GB of memory per vCPU.

CPU instruction support includes AVX and AVX-512F for vector processing, alongside cryptographic AES and standard bit manipulation instructions. Benchmark results reflect a stark divergence between per-thread and parallel throughput. In stress-ng evaluations, the single-core CPU performance registers at 1104.49, falling into the lower quartile of tested cloud environments. Conversely, the dense 96-thread execution capacity achieves a multi-core stress-ng score of 70674.73, placing it within the upper quartile.

The instance does not include local disk storage, necessitating external block storage volumes for persistent data and operating system installations. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, providing consistent data transfer for distributed workflows without bundled public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile centers capital value on the eight enterprise GPUs and high multi-threaded core count rather than single-threaded clock speed. The server is suited for multi-GPU deep learning training, distributed neural network inference, large-scale scientific simulations, and high-throughput computational workloads.
